cases.text: For both actual refusal setters, preserve the exact already-raised original instance and full type/traceback/context when another exception is being handled too. Do not fetch/discard, normalize, replace, retry or invoke a new exception factory; native refusal fields may record the unchanged existing failure classification.

At both actual setters with NULL raised indicator and an active handled original, retain the same instance via PyErr_GetHandledException and install its owned reference with PyErr_SetRaisedException. Its actual args/dict/notes/cause/context/traceback, aliases and cycles must remain unchanged by the setter and required in both receivers.

With no raised or handled original, use exactly the already-owned Root refusal instance, not a new normalized exception. Root preowned storage, copied borrowed Bindings, selected original_debit and full Root owner MOVE must agree on identity and one reference per actual ownership.

Before interpreter initialization or before the refusal object exists, Root fault keeps the native refusal without calling a Python error API. After final_caller_binding.transferred, Root fault must return without changing the exposed native record or using old Python references. Preserve original actual-caller initialized-runtime precondition; do not infer arbitrary late API safety.

For original contexts containing the preowned refusal or a preexisting cause/context cycle, neither changed setter may traverse/rewrite that causal chain or decref a replaced current exception. Compare complete original aliases before/after the setter; required later traceback propagation is distinct and must be represented, not deleted.

Exercise actual original_debit structural overflow/missing-provider/current-owner checks and Root provider refusal. Structural failure must not invoke provider/effects; real provider refusal preserves its exact pending/handled original. Success still debits same original pool before counters/effects; no extra allowance, cap change, refund, reset or new caller storage.

Follow native preSource initial_failure, actual caller entry_failure and invocation failure into their original preowned type/value/traceback fields. CommandReceive must move actual strong error owners once, not double-count borrowed refusal aliases; original required error graph/body/secondary routes cannot be replaced by type/message or a diagnostic pointer.

Run actual RootPerform -> CommandReceive -> cold_complete -> prebound FinalReceive on required normal and all failure cases once. No exposed tuple mutation, helper receipt or exit code establishes complete retirement. Unknown original graph, pending error, incomplete FD/mapping or lost admission must preserve exact unconfirmed state and stop the affected contour.

After a setter returns through actual native/Python caller, re-raised originals can acquire real traceback frames. Preserve refreshed complete errors/frame locals/caller objects through primary and secondary readers and final full-body consumption; acceptance of setter nonmutation is not acceptance of all later error state.

Bind actual selected interpreter/image/compiler ABI and required workload before execution. errors.c GetHandledException traverses the real exception-stack chain and takes an owned reference; do not call its cost constant or zero. Include actual stack/lookup/refcount/body/final costs in unchanged original caps. Exact upstream raw body and zero active patch targets for Python/errors.c are source evidence only.

Before accepting a combined candidate, join exact SOL135/136 actual Root manager/cursor/raw close producer and both native setter changes. Verify real complete error/wire/owner/retirement compatibility and all changed resource terms; preserve scoped credits only with exact dependencies and current input context. Do not overlay incompatible native changes or accept Sol's own implementation by Sol.

Keep original69/mandatory20 and full inherited positive/negative obligations, including later SOL135/136 required cases. Add these cases rather than substituting them. All current hash-only checks are NOT_RUN, not execution credit; no SourceReady, Root admission, qualification or release GO from this author package.
